fact: Title `fix: bug with set_option ... in in tactic analysis framework` has a type keyword and colon but no parenthesised area such as `(Tactic/TacticAnalysis)`.
The fix makes this linter filter infotrees by the enclosing command syntax under `withSetOptionIn`; other `withSetOptionIn` linters filtering infotrees by inner syntax are parallel code paths.
Changed `run` spells its lambda `fun _ => do` (arrow `=>`, binder `_`, `|>` pipe) and puts a `/- ... -/` block comment inside the body.
Test example proves `x = z` by consecutive `rw [xy]` then `rw [yz]` at the goal, mergeable into `rw [xy, yz]` (deliberate: it exercises the rwMerge linter).
Test example closes `x = z` by a manual rewrite chain `rw [xy]`, `rw [yz]` instead of one finishing tactic; the chain is the linter test's input.
Besides the fix and its regression test, the PR wraps the existing rwMerge/replaceWithGrind tests in a new `section declarations`, a reorganisation the fix does not need.
